idea-plugin.name: SPHIOR CODE
idea-plugin.description:
SPHIOR CODE — deterministic security scanning right in your JetBrains IDE: hard-coded secrets, insecure patterns mapped to CWE, and data-flow (taint) analysis.

  • No AI, no source upload. Detection is 100% deterministic and runs locally via a bundled language server. Your code never leaves your machine.
  • Same engine as the command line. The plugin bundles the language server from @sphior/scan, so the IDE and npx @sphior/scan in CI apply the same rules.
  • Fix with your own AI. Each finding carries why it matters and how to fix it, and a quick fix hands it to the AI assistant you already use — SPHIOR does not generate code for you.

Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript (+ JSX/TSX), Python, Go, PHP, Ruby, Java, C#, Rust, Kotlin, C, C++, Scala, Swift — analysed with real parsers (tree-sitter), not just regex.

Requires Node.js on PATH (or set SPHIOR_NODE_PATH). Depends on the LSP4IJ plugin.

Documentation: github.com/Toraastrta/sphior-code
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.2

  • Ships the current rule set, 2026.10.23-24, the same as @sphior/scan 0.1.8 on the command line.
  • New detections include weak ciphers in JavaScript/TypeScript and path traversal through fs functions imported by name; fewer false positives on private-key headers.
  • Inline acceptance with // sphior-ignore and // sphior-ignore-next-line, with a reason.
  • The fix prompt for an exposed secret no longer suggests rewriting git history.
  • New icon: the SPHIOR ring on black, matching the brand.
  • Description corrected: the plugin finds problems locally; it does not produce audit evidence on its own.
